newsitem.title: USA: AT&T credit unit cuts interest rates - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: AT&T credit unit cuts interest rates - WSJ.

text.p: AT&T Universal Card Services Corp is cutting interest rates from 18.15 percent to 13.85 percent for a lot of its credit-card customers, the Wall Street Journal reported on Tuesday.
The newspaper said the division of AT&T Corp's financial services unit would nevertheless keep the standard rate for new customers.
It cited a company spokesman as saying the permanent rate cut was done in time for the holiday season.
It said the spokesman declined to say how many of the company's cardholders would be offered the new rate.
